# MOMUTO
> MOMUTO designs and manufactures 100% customizable, professional-grade football and soccer kits. European design studio, full dye-sublimation printing (lifetime guarantee against peeling), no minimum order, a free 3D designer where every design loads finished, worldwide delivery in 25-30 days.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2023
- Headquarters: Europe (design), Asia (manufacturing)
- Product: Custom football/soccer kits (jerseys and shorts)
- Fabric: Polyester/elastane blend as standard on all kits — the same fabric others reserve for premium tiers only
- Printing: Full dye-sublimation (ink fused into fabric, never peels/cracks/fades)
- Minimum order: None (1 kit or 100+)
- Design options: (1) Ready to Play — a wall of 16+ finished designs by the MOMUTO studio; every design loads finished in the free real-time 3D designer (never a blank template), customize it or order it as it stands. (2) Professional design service (Bespoke) — a €15 deposit puts a designer on your concept, first mockup in 24-48h, revisions included; the deposit is credited in full to orders of 5+ jerseys, so it is free for a team order. (3) AI concept to real kit — submit your AI-generated design (ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.) and our expert designers adapt it into a production-ready, wearable kit (same €15 deposit terms).
- Pricing: From €21.90/jersey for orders of 10+. Single jersey €38.90. Designing in 3D is always free. Each season a curated selection of Ready to Play designs is discounted 10%.
- Long sleeves: optional per player, chosen on the cart roster. A long-sleeve jersey costs 3.00 EUR more than the short-sleeve price at any quantity (e.g. 21.90 becomes 24.90 at 10+). Default is short sleeves.
- Custom design deposit: The 3D designer and Ready to Play designs are free to use and customize. The professional/AI design service takes a €15 deposit to start — credited in full to any order of 5 or more jerseys, so free for a team order.
- Delivery: production 7-12 days + shipping 10-15 days — typically 25-30 days door to door, worldwide. More than 95% of orders arrive within this window.
- Fast lane: +€59 skips the production queue and adds shipping priority — saves roughly 7 days.
- Planning: start 7-9 weeks before you need jerseys in hand and confirm the order 4-5 weeks out. In practice teams spend 2-3 weeks deciding (the design vote, sponsor mockup approval, collecting payment) — longer than production itself. Size collection is NOT the slow part: full size lists usually arrive within 24 hours.
- Artwork: every crest and sponsor logo — uploaded to the 3D designer or sent in a brief — is cleaned and print-prepared by a designer before production.
- Audience: Amateur football (soccer) clubs, youth academies, club and rec leagues, college intramural sides, corporate teams, e-sports teams — in the US, the UK, Europe and worldwide
- Terminology: "Soccer" (US) and "football" (rest of world) refer to the same sport. MOMUTO is both a soccer jersey maker and a football kit designer — the same custom jersey, shorts and uniform either way.

## What Makes MOMUTO Different
- Every design in the 3D designer loads finished, in an intentional colourway — Owayo/Spized templates load as blank shapes in default colours
- Ready to Play: finished designs by the MOMUTO studio, ready to order or customize — built for teams that are short on time, not short on ideas
- Polyester/elastane blend included as standard — competitors charge extra for this fabric
- No minimum order — from 1 jersey to full club kits
- AI concept manufacturing — the only kit maker that takes your AI-generated jersey concept and turns it into a real, wearable kit. Bring your ChatGPT or Midjourney design to life.
